briefs.claim_en: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including VOA News, PBS.org, Astronomy.com, Time.com, and Wikipedia, confirm that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed its Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. VOA News and PBS.org specify the landing occurred on Wednesday, August 23, 2023. Time.com notes the landing time as 8:34 AM ET, while Wikipedia states 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC). ResearchExperts.in also supports this information, though its publication date of June 15, 2026, is in the future.

briefs.claim_en: India became the first country to land a spacecraft in the Moon's south pole region.
briefs.brief_en: Several news outlets and information sources, including VOA News, PBS.org, TheGuardian.com, Wikipedia, ResearchExperts.in, and Eoportal.org, state that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft in the Moon's south pole region. TheGuardian.com, published on August 22, 2023, explicitly reports this. BOOM Fact Check, in an article published on August 29, 2023, rated as false the claim that China was the first country to land on the Moon's South Pole, indirectly supporting India's claim to be the first.
